title: Neighborhood pacing for first-time Tokyo trips
content: Group Shinjuku, Shibuya, Harajuku, and nearby west-side neighborhoods together to avoid cross-city backtracking. Put Asakusa, Ueno, Akihabara, and Tokyo Station area on separate east-side days when possible.

title: Museum and landmark clustering in central Paris
content: Cluster Louvre, Tuileries, Palais Royal, and the Seine quays into the same central day. Keep Eiffel Tower and Trocadero with west-side activities to reduce metro transfers.

title: Traffic-aware planning for Sao Paulo
content: Plan Sao Paulo days by area because cross-city traffic can be heavy. Pair Avenida Paulista, Jardins, and MASP together, and keep Ibirapuera-focused activities in a separate south-central block.
